meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 把 H&E 组织切片切成 224×224 小图,按你指定的基因符号列表,预测每个小图内这些基因的空间表达量(log1p-CPM),形成按网格排列的表达矩阵。
howto.when: 当你需要从 H&E 染色切片得到空间基因表达(log1p-CPM),按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或先用 histolab 切块后做全片预测时;输入图像需为约 20 倍下的 224×224 RGB 图。

say.text: 把这批 224×224 的 tile 按基因列表批量预测,输出表达矩阵。
say.note: 需要你提供 tile 和基因列表;结果按传入基因顺序排列。

howto.what_en: Maps a 224x224 H&E histology tile to spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for each queried gene symbol, returning a tiles-by-genes matrix aligned with the input gene list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need transcriptome-wide spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM from H&E slides at ~20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Use DeepSpot-M to predict EPCAM and CD3D expression in this H&E slide.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values per gene on the tile grid.

say_en.text: Batch-predict the gene list across these 224x224 tiles and return the expression matrix.
say_en.note: Tiles and gene list are required; columns follow your gene order.

say_en.text: Tile the whole slide into 224x224 crops with histolab, then run DeepSpot-M prediction.
